Class L298nMotor

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.motor.L298nMotor
All Implemented Interfaces:
BaseMotor, DCMotor
public final class L298nMotor extends Object implements DCMotor
One brushed DC-motor channel of an L298N dual H-bridge module.

Connect enablePin to ENA or ENB (with that module's jumper removed), and in1Pin/in2Pin to its two direction inputs. Create and initialise one channel for each yellow TT motor at startup. Power is a PWM percentage; this open-loop driver deliberately implements DCMotor, rather than RegulatedMotor, because the pictured TT motors have no encoder.
